title: Causal-Guided Active Learning for Debiasing Large Language Models

bias_targets.target: LLM-specific biases (Position, Verbosity, and Format bias)
bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model response selection on conversational benchmark datasets (Chatbot and MT-Bench) by comparing the model's choices against human-majority annotations, which includes swapping response orders to test for position bias and observing preferences for longer or specifically formatted text.

bias_targets.target: Syntactic and Heuristic biases (Lexical overlap, Subsequence, and Constituent bias)
bias_targets.methodology: Measuring model accuracy on Natural Language Inference (NLI) benchmarks using the MNLI and HANS datasets to detect whether the LLM relies on superficial statistical correlations and word-overlap heuristics rather than genuine semantic reasoning.

bias_targets.target: Stereotype and Social biases (Gender, Race/Ethnicity, Religion, Sexual orientation, Age, Socioeconomic status, Physical appearance, and Occupational bias)
bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model accuracy on underspecified multiple-choice question-answering datasets (BBQ and UNQOVER) to determine if the model incorrectly relies on stereotypical associations to answer questions when sufficient contextual information is missing.
